question: Which player was widely known by the name of Flying Sikh?
solution:
The correct answer is **Milkha Singh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Milkha Singh:-**

 
 
• **He is widely known by the name of the "Flying Sikh".**
 
• He was an Indian track and field sprinter who specialized in the 400 meters.
 
• He was the first Indian athlete to win a gold medal at the Asian Games and the Commonwealth Games in the 400 meters event.
 
• He also competed in the 1960 Summer Olympics, where he finished fourth in the 400 meters final, just 0.13 seconds behind the bronze medalist.
 
• Milkha Singh retired from athletics in 1966.
 
• **He was awarded the Padma Shri, India's fourth highest civilian honor, in 1959, and the Padma Bhushan, India's third highest civilian honor, in 2001. He died in 2021 at the age of 91.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Arshdeep Singh:-**

 
 
• He is a young Indian cricketer who is quickly making a name for himself.
 
• He is a left-arm medium-fast bowler and left-handed lower-order batter. 
 
• He made his debut for Punjab in domestic cricket in 2018 and was picked up by the Punjab Kings in the Indian Premier League (IPL) auction the same year.
 
 
 
• **Harbhajan Singh:-**
 
 
• He is one of the greatest off-spinners to have ever played cricket.
 
• He is known for his guile, wicket-taking ability, and aggressive style of bowling.
 
• Harbhajan was a part of the Indian team that won the 2007 T20 World Cup and the 2011 ODI World Cup.
 
• He is also the only bowler to have taken a hat-trick in all three formats of the game.
 
 
 
• **Yuvraj Singh:-**
 
 
• He is one of the most iconic cricketers of all time.
 
• He is known for his all-round ability, his big-match performances, and his fighting spirit.
 
• Yuvraj played a major role in India's victory in the 2007 T20 World Cup and the 2011 ODI World Cup.
 
• He was named the Player of the Tournament in the 2011 World Cup, where he scored 362 runs and took 15 wickets.
